title: ResonateEngine module manifest
description: One per module, written as resonate.module.toml beside its sources. Every field lives inside the single [resonate.module] table; the root table is the document's kind marker, mirroring [resonate.host] and future [resonate.<kind>] sections. Picked up by taplo through the #:schema first-line comment. The cross-file invariants (ids unique, every requirement provided, descriptor and build table agreeing) are enforced by scripts/module_check.lua on every build.

resonate.description: The engine namespace. A manifest has exactly one table in it.

module.description: What this module declares about itself.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identity. Unique across modules and used by the dependency graph; never shown to a user.

name.description: Display name for logs and editor lists. Carries no identity, and two modules may share one.

version.description: Semantic version of the module itself, not of the ABI.

abi.description: Major ABI version the module was built against.

min_host_abi.description: Lowest host major ABI this module accepts. The descriptor derives one from the other, so the two fields must be equal.

summary.description: One line describing what the module is for.

provides.description: Capabilities this module publishes. Each one belongs to exactly one module.

requires.description: Capabilities the host must resolve before on_attach runs.

optional.description: Capabilities that may be absent. The consumer checks the handle it gets back.

depends_on.description: Modules that must attach first, independent of capabilities.

capabilityId.description: A capability id: 'Resonate' plus dotted PascalCase segments, as declared by CapabilityTraits in a capability header.
